verdict.rationale: WezTerm's source is published in a public GitHub repository, and community comments about GitHub issues being fixed quickly support that the source is publicly readable. The pack never states which license covers the code, so the 'open license' half of the story is not evidenced. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of an open-source license (e.g. a LICENSE file or license name), first-party docs on source availability and building from source.
